notes:
It opens like an audiobook now.

A chapter starts by announcing the series and the chapter — "Pick Me Up, Infinite Gacha. Chapter 1." — taken from your library rather than read off the cover art, so it's the real name and the real number every time.

• The scanlation credits are gone: the proofreader's name, the site watermark however it's signed, and the cover's own lettering.
• It doesn't rush. There's a beat between balloons now, a longer one at a panel break, and longer still when someone else starts talking. The voice was never fast — there was simply no pause anywhere.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.

Voices are still the open problem: characters change mid-scene and gender isn't considered yet.
